summary: Sets up and maintains LGTM Studio's Node.js 26 workspace, toolchain, Herdr plugin manifest and copied third-party packages.

sections.heading: What this project is
sections.why: What LGTM Studio is and that it is not a Synapse fork; every scope needs it to stay in bounds.

sections.heading: Status
sections.why: Says when application code may be added; binds any change.

sections.heading: Language
sections.why: TypeScript, Effect 4 with the look-it-up rule, and Node.js 26; binds all code in every scope.

sections.heading: How agents are run
sections.why: ACP first and the one delivery interface; shapes the runner and the contracts.

sections.heading: Rules
sections.why: Never push upstream, credit copied code, keep the lists, follow SECURITY.md, API parity, no team shapes, no commits unless asked; binds any change.

sections.heading: Writing style for documents
sections.why: Applies to any document, README or third_party note a unit writes. When in doubt, keep.
